description: Angular component for a mobile app QR code widget, including initialization, rendering, and dynamic resizing logic.

classes.name: MobileAppQrcodeWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying a QR code for mobile app linking, with dynamic resizing and deep link management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, fetches settings if not provided, and sets up resize observer.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up observers and timers when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: navigateByDeepLink
methods.description: Opens the deep link URL in a new tab when triggered.

methods.name: initMobileAppQRCode
methods.description: Fetches the deep link and sets up periodic refresh based on TTL.

methods.name: updateQRCode
methods.description: Generates a QR code SVG from the link using the 'qrcode' library.
